$description: Comic-style visual presets for LTX image/video generation. Each style appends prompt_suffix (appearance) and negative_suffix (what to avoid) to the base prompt.

styles.prompt_suffix: flat vector comic style, bold clean outlines, cel-shaded color blocks, limited palette with high contrast, comic panel aesthetic, crisp edges, graphic novel look, no gradients, pop art influence
styles.negative_suffix: 3d render, realistic, photographic, soft shading, gradient, blur, depth of field, lens flare, motion blur

styles.prompt_suffix: watercolor comic style, soft ink outlines, translucent washes, gentle color bleeding, textured paper grain, hand-painted feel, artistic brushstrokes, dreamy atmosphere, muted palette
styles.negative_suffix: 3d render, realistic, photographic, hard edges, cel shading, vector art, digital flat colors, sharp contrast

styles.prompt_suffix: traditional anime cel animation style, clean lineart, vibrant flat colors, cel shading with two-tone highlights, hand-painted backgrounds, 1990s anime aesthetic, crisp character silhouettes, subtle film grain
styles.negative_suffix: 3d render, realistic, photographic, painterly, watercolor, soft focus, motion blur, lens effects

styles.prompt_suffix: Korean manhwa realistic style, semi-realistic rendering, detailed facial features, soft gradients on skin, dramatic lighting with rim highlights, vertical scroll composition, polished digital art, urban fantasy aesthetic
styles.negative_suffix: flat vector, cartoon, chibi, exaggerated proportions, western comic, pixel art, low poly, 3d render
